claim: Capital One Shopping estimates Apple Pay's 2025 revenue at $3.0 billion and 2022 revenue at $1.9 billion, but attributes these figures only to its own team's compilation of publicly available data, not to a named analyst or research firm.
scope_conditions: Page updated July 22, 2026; no disclosed methodology for the 2025 figure specifically
quoted_support: Apple Pay's 2025 revenue was an estimated $3.0 billion. In 2022, Apple Pay produced a revenue of $1.9 billion... These data and insights were compiled by the Capital One Shopping team based on publicly available data.

claim: Third-party Apple Pay 2025 revenue estimates diverge substantially: Capital One Shopping states $3.0 billion while grabon.com/electroiq.com (extrapolating the same underlying Loup Ventures 2019 base) state $4.45 billion -- a roughly 48% spread between the two chains for the same year, despite both agreeing on the $1.9 billion 2022 base figure.
stance_target: reliability of aggregator-sourced Apple Pay revenue figures
scope_conditions: 2025 estimate comparison across two independent aggregator chains
quoted_support: Apple Pay's 2025 revenue was an estimated $3.0 billion.

claim: Apple Pay generates revenue through multiple distinct streams: fees charged to banks that support it (interchange-style issuer fee), plus interest and late fees from Apple Pay Cash and Apple Card.
quoted_support: Apple Pay generates revenue through fees charged to banks that support it, as well as interest and late fees from Apple Pay Cash and Apple Card.
